title: 第12章 老夫与他势不两立！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 炎文帝看着一众文官的脸色，只觉得憋在心头的一口恶气，终于舒畅了。可惜，宰相赵桧回乡祭祖还没回来，不然真想看看他现在的脸色，是何等的精彩。“诸位爱卿，看到了吧？这就是民间的声音。”“民心，不可负！”炎文帝站了起来，目光睥睨全场：“一个小少年，都知道收拾旧山河，朝天阙，诸位爱卿都是我大炎国之重臣，岂能连一个民间百姓都不如？”“陛下，国家大事不是诗词文章，切不可因为一首词，就草率定国策啊！”唐敬立即站出来拱手说道。炎文帝接下来要说什么，已经很清楚了，再不阻止就晚了。炎文帝目光冷冷盯着唐敬，不能因为一首词草率定国策，然后等北狄大军兵临城下，期望你这薄情寡义的家伙保护朕吗？“可以，只要你们能以文臣的角度，写一首能与这首求战词媲美的诗词，朕就收回成命。”炎文帝目光扫过全场，而听到他的话一群文官脸都绿了。他们求和，说直白点就是投降行为，写一首带有投降意思的诗词劝谏皇帝，别说他们写不出来，就是能写出来谁敢写？会遗臭万年的好吧！一群武将也都在挤眉弄眼，吐舌抖腰，挑衅他们。你们平时不是很狂吗？现在再嘚瑟一个看看啊！“既然写不出来，那就听旨吧！”炎文帝一甩衣袖，冷眸盯着全场：“北狄如果敢犯边，这一仗，朕打定了。”“一个月内，兵部整顿好北境各道各军兵马和军备，户部必须筹集五十万大军所需的粮草。”“一个月后朕亲自验收，没有完成的，斩立决！”“退朝！”炎文帝没有给群臣反驳的机会，转身就走。皇帝走了，但整个大殿依旧一片死寂。武将依旧有些难以置信，没想到上阵杀敌马上封侯的幸福来得这么突然。文臣却还在懵逼，他们计划好好的，今日无论如何都要说服皇帝和谈，没想到因为一首诗词，生生将结局扭转了。“查！给我查！查出写这首词的人是谁，老夫与他势不两立！”回过神，唐敬怒火中烧恨欲狂。一众文臣也都怒不可遏，必须将这个坏了他们大事的混账东西，揪出来，让他体验一下什么叫生不如死。“哼，那位写词的小兄弟，现在开始是我狄苍的忘年交，谁敢动他，老子弄死谁。”老将军冲着唐敬等人扬了扬拳头，转身离开了。一群武将也都心情大好，全都走路带风，气得一众文官咬牙切齿。唐敬虽然愤怒，但事到如今已经改变不了什么，只能先下朝，将朝中变故飞鸽传书给丞相。“唐侍郎，陛下召见。”陈貂寺站在前方，笑吟吟地做了个请的手势。唐敬心头顿时一个激灵，今日陛下给他的感觉很奇怪，早朝上看了他好几次。他在脑海中将这段时间所有事情都想了一遍，好像这段时间没做错事，都是跟着陛下的步伐走，没有被责罚，反而是多次被表扬啊！就算是和北狄的战与和，那是朝政，有争论有争吵正常，陛下不能因为丞相不在他领头，就要收拾他吧？“公公，陛下找我何事？”唐敬快步跟上陈貂寺，一张百两银票便塞了过去。陈貂寺熟练收下银票，低声笑道：“和令公子有关。”客气啥？陛下在意的唐家那小子吃不饱穿不暖，这家伙倒是大方出手就是一百两。这钱不要都对不起咱家。至于和令公子有关，咱家说是哪位公子了吗？唐敬一怔，眼睛顿时亮了起来。想必陈貂寺说的是画儿，哈哈，果然画儿的优秀，连陛下都发现了。只要陛下承认，那他就能名正言顺将唐画扶为嫡子。“臣，参见陛下，陛下万福金安。”刚进御书房，唐敬恭敬行礼，声音却抑制不住的激动。炎文帝正在批阅奏章，顿时有些懵。怎么个意思？朕叫你过来是敲打你，朕敲打你你很高兴是吧？“唐侍郎，唐家的嫡子是谁？”炎文帝放下朱笔，开门见山。“回陛下，唐家嫡子是唐画……”唐敬下意识说道。话出口，他才意识到皇帝的语气不对。抬头，就看到皇帝正笑吟吟地看着他，道：“唐侍郎，你再好好想想，唐家的嫡子……是谁？”唐敬瞬间脊背发凉，汗流浃背，连忙改口道：“回陛下，臣的嫡子，是唐逸，但是，唐逸顽劣……”“嗯，这就对了。”炎文帝笑着打断唐敬，起身向他走来。“朕昨日出宫时遇到了他们兄妹俩，嗯，是两个不错的孩子。”“见到这两个孩子，朕终于相信唐侍郎是清正廉洁了。”“以后谁要是敢弹劾唐侍郎贪污，朕肯定诛其九族。”炎文帝亲手将唐敬扶起来，面带自责：“说起来，哎，是朕之罪啊！朕没想到堂堂朝中四品大员的俸禄，竟然养不活一家子人。”“见到唐逸兄妹瘦骨嶙峋，身体羸弱，衣服破旧，朕很心疼……”扑通！唐敬刚站起来，听到这话双腿一软，重新重重跪在了地上。整张脸冷汗涔涔，后背都被汗水湿透了，一颗心也直接悬到了九霄云外。什么自责，皇帝明显是反话正说，这是在敲打他呢！当年他接颜霜玉回来，无数人都说他薄情寡义，现在又见到瘦骨嶙峋的唐逸和唐音，那皇帝肯定以为他们俩在唐家遭到了虐待。堂堂朝廷四品大员虐待儿女，传出去大炎的脸面何存？该死的，这畜生什么时候出去不行？非得昨日出去！唐敬原本想说这是颜霜玉对唐逸的历练，但话到嘴边忍住了，皇帝需要他的解释吗？不需要！“陛下，臣惶恐，臣知罪……”唐敬脑袋贴着地上，大气不敢出。“爱卿言重了，爱卿何罪之有？”炎文帝弯腰将唐敬拉起来，笑道：“朕叫爱卿过来，只是和爱卿叙叙家常，没有要怪罪爱卿的意思。”“昨日，朕已赐给唐逸六百两，并嘱咐他对自己好点，只准留着自己用，不许给别人，但方才却有人来报，朕给那孩子的银票，被别人用了，甚至连银票，都重新回到了朕的手上！你说，究竟是谁忤逆了朕的意思呢……”扑通！唐敬再度重重地跪在地上，头皮都炸了！什么？昨日唐逸那六百两，是……是陛下给的？是……皇帝……给的？！这小畜生，是陛下给的你不说？而且那银票，除了自己的夫人和唐画唐浩兄弟俩，还能被谁用？陛下今天是第二次敲打他了！完了，完了……坑爹啊！
content_en: Emperor Yanwen looked at the faces of all the civil servants and felt that the bad breath he had been holding in his heart was finally relieved.It's a pity that Prime Minister Zhao Hui has not returned from his hometown to worship his ancestors. Otherwise, I really want to see how wonderful his face is now."Dear lords, have you seen this? This is the voice of the people." "The people's hearts cannot be let down!" Emperor Yan Wen stood up and looked at the audience: "A young man knows how to clean up the old mountains and rivers and build the sky. Dear lords,They are all important ministers of our country, how can they be inferior to ordinary people? ""Your Majesty, national affairs are not poems and articles.We must not make hasty decisions about national policies just because of a poem!" Tang Jing immediately stood up and said.It was already clear what Emperor Yanwen was going to say next, and it would be too late if he didn't stop it.Emperor Yanwen stared at Tang Jing coldly. Can't he hastily decide on national policy based on a poem, and then wait for the Beidi army to come to the city and expect you, a heartless and unjust guy, to protect me?"Yes, as long as you can write a poem that is comparable to this petition from the perspective of civil servants, I will take back my order." Emperor Yanwen glanced across the audience, and the faces of the civil servants turned green when they heard his words.They sued for peace, which to put it bluntly was an act of surrender. They wrote a poem with the meaning of surrender to admonish the emperor. Not to mention that they couldn't write it, but if they could, who would dare to write it?It will be infamy for eternity, okay!A group of generals were also winking, sticking out their tongues and shaking their waists to provoke them.Aren't you usually crazy?Now take another look!"Since you can't write it down, just listen to the order!" Emperor Yanwen flicked his sleeves and stared at the audience coldly: "If Beidi dares to invade the border, I have decided on this battle." "Within a month, the Ministry of War will organize all the troops and horses in the northern border.and armaments, the Ministry of Revenue must raise the food and fodder needed for the army of 500,000."I will personally inspect it in a month. If it is not completed, I will be executed immediately!"Emperor Yanwen did not give the ministers a chance to refute, and turned around and left.The emperor left, but the whole hall was still silent.The general was still a little unbelievable. He did not expect the happiness of going into battle to kill the enemy and immediately becoming a marquis to come so suddenly.The civil servants were still confused. They had planned well and wanted to persuade the emperor to negotiate peace today no matter what. Unexpectedly, because of a poem, the ending was reversed."Check! Check for me! Find out who wrote this poem. I am incompatible with him!" When Tang Jing came back to his senses, he was furious and filled with hatred.All the civil servants were also furious. They must find out this bastard who ruined their affairs and let him experience what life is worse than death."Hmph, that little brother who wrote the lyrics is now my old friend Di Cang. I will kill anyone who dares to touch him." The old general raised his fist at Tang Jing and others, turned and left.A group of military generals were also in a good mood, and they all walked with a wind, which made all the civil servants gnash their teeth.Although Tang Jing was angry, he could not change anything now. He could only go to the court first and send a letter to the prime minister about the incident in the court."Tang Shilang, Your Majesty has summoned you." Chen Diao Si stood in front and made an invitation gesture with a smile.Tang Jing's heart suddenly became excited. His Majesty gave him a very strange feeling today. He had looked at him several times in the morning.He thought about everything during this period in his mind. It seemed that he had done nothing wrong during this period. He followed His Majesty's footsteps. Instead of being punished, he was praised many times!Even if it's war and peace with Beidi, that's government affairs, and it's normal to have arguments and quarrels. Your Majesty can't deal with the Prime Minister just because he's not taking the lead, right?"Eunuch, what does your Majesty want from me?" Tang Jing quickly followed Chen Diao Si and stuffed a hundred taels of silver note over him.Chen Diao Si skillfully accepted the banknote and laughed in a low voice: "It has something to do with Mr. Ling." Why are you so polite?The boy from the Tang family whom Your Majesty cared about didn't have enough to eat or clothes to keep warm, but this guy generously offered a hundred taels.Don't let this money go to our family.As for the connection with Young Master Ling, have we said which Young Master it is?Tang Jing was startled, and his eyes suddenly lit up.Chen Diao Si must be talking about Hua'er, haha. Sure enough, the painting is so good that even His Majesty noticed it.As long as His Majesty admits it, he can legitimately support Tang Hua as his legitimate son."Your Majesty, I wish you all the best." As soon as he entered the imperial study, Tang Jing saluted respectfully, but his voice could not suppress the excitement.Emperor Yanwen was reviewing the memorial and was suddenly confused.What do you mean?I asked you to come here to beat you. Are you happy that I am beating you?"Tang Shilang, who is the legitimate son of the Tang family?" Emperor Yanwen put down his ink pen and got straight to the point."Your Majesty, the Tang family's legitimate son is Tang Hua..." Tang Jing said subconsciously.As the words came out of his mouth, he realized that the emperor's tone was wrong.Looking up, he saw the emperor looking at him with a smile and said: "Tang Shilang, think about it again, who is the legitimate son of the Tang family?" Tang Jing instantly felt a chill running down his spine and was sweating profusely. He quickly changed his words and said, "Your Majesty, my legitimate son is Tang Yi, but Tang Yi is naughty..." "Well, that's right." Emperor Yan Wen interrupted Tang Jing with a smile, stood up and walked towards him."I met these two brothers and sisters when I left the palace yesterday. Well, they are two good children." "Seeing these two children, I finally believe that Shilang Tang is honest and upright." "If anyone dares to impeach Shilang Tang for corruption in the future, I will definitely punish the nine clans." Emperor Yanwen personally punished him.Tang Jing helped him up, with a look of remorse on his face: "Speaking of which, it's my fault! I didn't expect that the salary of a dignified fourth-rank official in the court could not support a family." "I feel very sad when I see brother and sister Tang Yi who are skinny, weak, and their clothes are shabby..." Plop!Tang Jing just stood up. When he heard these words, his legs softened and he knelt heavily on the ground again.His whole face was covered in cold sweat, his back was soaked with sweat, and his heart was in the sky.What self-blame? The emperor was obviously saying the opposite. This was a slap on his face!When he brought Yan Shuangyu back, countless people said that he was heartless and unrighteous. Now that he saw the skinny Tang Yi and Tang Yin, the emperor must have thought that they were abused in the Tang family.A dignified fourth-rank official in the imperial court abused his children. How could Dayan's face be saved when word spread?Damn it, when can this beast get out?I had to go out yesterday!Tang Jing originally wanted to say that this was Yan Shuangyu's experience with Tang Yi, but he held back the words. Did the emperor need his explanation?unnecessary!"Your Majesty, I am terrified and aware of my guilt..." Tang Jing put his head on the ground, not daring to express his anger."Ai Qing's words are serious, what crime does Ai Qing have?" Emperor Yanwen bent down and pulled Tang Jing up, and said with a smile: "I asked Ai Qing to come over, just to talk about family affairs with Ai Qing, and I didn't want to blame you.
title_en: Chapter 12 I am at odds with him!
